A bill for an act relating to education; providing for a grant for literacy interventions; requiring a report; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; DYSLEXIA. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Department of Education.+]

[+The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota.+]

[+(a) For a grant to the Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota to provide free evidence-based literacy interventions to students who are reading below grade level and are enrolled in public schools where a majority of students are eligible for free or reduced-price meals: +]

[+$ +]

[+450,000 +]

[+..... +]

[+2026 +]

[+$ +]

[+450,000 +]

[+..... +]

[+2027 +]

[+(b) Grant funds must be used to support tutor training and compensation, curricular materials, program delivery, and program administration. +]

[+(c) The Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota must provide a detailed report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees having jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education and higher education by January 15 of each year until 2028 describing how grant funds were used, and progress made toward improving the literacy proficiency of participating students. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; providing for a grant for literacy interventions; requiring a report; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; DYSLEXIA.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated.

Subd. 2.

Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota.

(a) For a grant to the Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota to provide free evidence-based literacy interventions to students who are reading below grade level and are enrolled in public schools where a majority of students are eligible for free or reduced-price meals:

$

450,000

.....

2026

$

450,000

.....

2027

(b) Grant funds must be used to support tutor training and compensation, curricular materials, program delivery, and program administration.

(c) The Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota must provide a detailed report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees having jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education and higher education by January 15 of each year until 2028 describing how grant funds were used, and progress made toward improving the literacy proficiency of participating students.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.
additions: The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated.

(a) For a grant to the Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota to provide free evidence-based literacy interventions to students who are reading below grade level and are enrolled in public schools where a majority of students are eligible for free or reduced-price meals:
(b) Grant funds must be used to support tutor training and compensation, curricular materials, program delivery, and program administration.

(c) The Dyslexia Institute of Minnesota must provide a detailed report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees having jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education and higher education by January 15 of each year until 2028 describing how grant funds were used, and progress made toward improving the literacy proficiency of participating students.
